verdict.rationale: Semgrep's rule-defined fix docs say fixes can be applied directly to files with the `--autofix` flag, so developers can act on findings rather than only read reports. Marketing pages also claim AI-assisted 'scan and fix' remediation. Missing for 10: detail on suggested fixes in PR comments or the IDE, any documentation of the AI-generated remediation beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autofix quality.
